saints.name: The Transfiguration of the Lord
saints.title: Feast of the Lord
saints.shortBlurb: The revelation of Christ's glory on the mountain before Peter, James, and John…
biography: The Gospels recount that Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain, where he was transfigured before them: his face shone like the sun and his garments became dazzling white. Moses and Elijah appeared conversing with him, and from a bright cloud the Father's voice declared, 'This is my beloved Son; listen to him.'

The Church has kept this feast in the East from early centuries, and Pope Callixtus III extended it to the whole Latin Church in 1457 in thanksgiving for the deliverance of Belgrade from the Turks the year before. The mystery discloses Christ's divine glory to strengthen the disciples for the scandal of the Cross that was to come.
saints.knownFor: The manifestation of Christ's divine glory before his Passion.
